description:
Typed relations for a concept in the OT+NT concept graph: broader/narrower
    (taxonomy), causes, part_of, symbol_of, fulfills, same_as (alternate name or
    translation equivalent, e.g. Christ/Messiah), contrasts — each hand-reviewed
    against cited evidence and returned with that reason ('why:'), see DESIGN.md #5.
    Excludes the much larger 'associated' tier by default (~143,000 mechanical
    shared-evidence edges, mostly unreviewed) — pass verb='associated' for it; each
    associated edge shows the shared verse or cross-reference that produced it.
    verb optional: restrict to one verb (broader | narrower | causes | part_of |
    symbol_of | fulfills | same_as | contrasts | associated).
name: get_concept_relations
